sources.title: A comprehensive review of image caption generation
sources.snippet: The paper emphasizes the importance of datasets, evaluation metrics, and optimization techniques for training image captioning models. Highlighting practical applications in healthcare, autonomous vehicles, and entertainment, the review underlines the broad-ranging implications of image caption generation.

sources.title: Image Captioning Evaluation in the Age of Multimodal LLMs: Challenges ...
sources.snippet: The evaluation of machine-generated image captions is a complex and evolving challenge. With the advent of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), image captioning has become a core task, increasing the need for robust and reliable evaluation metrics. sources.snippet: The dynamic image captioning model in Xian et al. (2022a) constructs a route space with several layers within the encoder based on three separate feature extraction blocks and uses grid characteristics to account for the localization of regional ones.
